ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
initialization_sequence: 1. PCD turns on antenna driver; ≥ 5 ms guard time allows PICC POR + OTP load.
2. PCD transmits REQA (0x26, 7-bit short frame, no parity, no CRC).
3. Any PICC in IDLE replies ATQA (2 bytes LSB-first); PCD parses UID size (00 = 4 B, 01 = 7 B, 10 = 10 B) and AC bitmap.
4. PCD enters Cascade Level 1 with SEL = 0x93, NVB = 0x20 (anti-collision; 0 valid bits).
5. PICC(s) reply UID-CL1[0..3] + BCC. If bit collision: PCD bisects, updates NVB, retransmits; loop until NVB = 0x70.
6. PCD transmits full SELECT (SEL + NVB = 0x70 + UID-CL1 + BCC + CRC_A). PICC replies SAK + CRC_A.
7. If SAK b3 = 1 (UID-CL1[0] was Cascade Tag 0x88), repeat at CL2 (SEL = 0x95) and possibly CL3 (SEL = 0x97).
8. PCD now has the complete UID + final SAK + (ATQA already buffered).
9. (If SAK b6 = 1) PCD transmits RATS (0xE0 + PARAM = FSDI<<4 | CID) → PICC replies ATS.
10. (Optional) PCD transmits PPS (0xD0 | CID + 0x11 + DS/DR) to negotiate 212/424/848 kbps; PICC replies PPS-RSP.
11. PCD waits SFGT (Startup Frame Guard Time) before first I-Block.
12. PCD is now in T_CL_ACTIVE and can carry application APDUs in I-Blocks.
anti_collision_loop_sequence: 3. PICCs reply with the bits beyond NVB.
4. If no collision: PICCs converge; PCD reads UID-CLn[0..3] + BCC.
5. If collision at bit k: PCD chooses bit-k = 1 (or 0) and updates NVB to (k+1 valid bits).
6. Repeat steps 2-5 until NVB = 0x70 (40 valid bits = full UID-CLn + BCC).
7. PCD sends final SELECT (NVB = 0x70 + CRC_A) → PICC replies SAK.
type_b_initialization_sequence: 1. PCD turns on antenna; ≥ 5 ms PICC POR guard.
2. PCD transmits REQB (APf = 0x05 + AFI + PARAM = REQB | N slots + CRC_B).
3. PICC(s) randomly pick slot k ∈ [0, N-1].
4. PCD transmits Slot-MARKER for k = 1..N-1 to scan all slots.
5. PICC in matching slot replies ATQB (12 bytes: 0x50 + PUPI + Application Data + Protocol Info + CRC_B).
6. PCD transmits ATTRIB (0x1D + PUPI + Param1..Param4 + Higher-INF + CRC_B) to select a specific PICC.
7. PCD now in T=CL active for the selected Type B PICC.
rats_ats_sequence: 1. PCD verifies SAK b6 = 1 (PICC supports T=CL).
2. PCD transmits RATS (0xE0 + PARAM byte + CRC_A).
3. PICC replies ATS (TL + T0 + optional TA(1)/TB(1)/TC(1) + historical bytes + CRC_A).
4. PCD extracts FSC = lookup(FSCI), FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI, SFGT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^SFGI, DS/DR bit-rate support.
5. PCD waits ≥ SFGT before transmitting first I-Block.
i_block_round_trip_sequence: 1. PCD assembles APDU into I-Block payload (≤ FSC - overhead bytes).
2. PCD computes CRC_A; sets PCB.b1 = current PCD block number N_PCD (alternates 0/1 per success).
4. PICC validates CRC_A + parity + block number; if OK, processes APDU; replies with own I-Block (block number = N_PICC).
5. PCD validates PICC reply; toggles N_PCD for next exchange.
6. If PICC needs more time, it replies S(WTX) with multiplier; PCD extends FWT and re-waits.
7. If PICC CRC/parity error, PCD detects no reply within FWT → PCD retransmits R(NAK) (or I-Block if first transmission).
halt_sequence: 1. PCD has selected a PICC and wants to enumerate others.
3. PICC silently transitions ACTIVE → HALT (no reply on success).
4. PCD verifies by transmitting REQA; PICC in HALT does NOT reply.
5. PCD then transmits WUPA to ALL PICCs (including the HALTed one if it should be re-engaged later) or continues anti-collision for the next PICC in field.
deselect_sequence_layer_4: 2. PICC replies S(DESELECT) ack (PCB = 0xC2 + CRC_A) and transitions T_CL_ACTIVE → HALT.
3. PCD may turn off field or re-enumerate.
wtx_sequence_layer_4: 1. PICC determines it needs more than FWT to complete a command.
2. PICC transmits S(WTX) (PCB = 0xF2 + WTXM × 1 byte + CRC_A); WTXM = wait-time extension multiplier 1..59.
3. PCD acknowledges by transmitting S(WTX) reply with same WTXM.
4. PCD extends FWT to WTXM × FWT for this exchange only.
5. PICC must now respond within the extended FWT or PCD declares error.
get_version_command_sequence_layer_4_app: 1. PCD transmits I-Block carrying APDU 0x60 GetVersion in INF.
2. PICC (MIFARE Ultralight EV1 / Plus EV1/EV2 / DESFire EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light) computes 7-byte GetVersion response.
3. PICC replies I-Block carrying response: VendorID + HW_ProductType + HW_ProductSubType + HW_Major + HW_Minor + HW_StorageSize + HW_Protocol.
4. PCD parses byte 2 HW_ProductType to deterministically identify the family.
5. (Optional) PCD chains and reads software version block 2 (SW_*) with a follow-up GetVersion.
multi_picc_enumeration_sequence: 2. Anti-collision loop selects first PICC (PICC_1); PCD records UID_1 + SAK_1.
4. PCD polls with WUPA (not REQA — to include any HALTed PICC for re-polling).
5. PICCs in field (excluding PICC_1, now in HALT) reply ATQA.
6. Anti-collision selects next PICC; loop repeats.
7. Loop terminates when no PICC replies to WUPA within fdt_listen.
field_loss_recovery_sequence: 1. PCD detects loss of envelope at receive path or external field-strength sensor.
2. PCD aborts pending T=CL exchange (block-number state lost).
3. On field-restoration, PCD restarts at step 1 of initialization_sequence (REQA / REQB).
